settings.pluginConsole.actionAllowLong: Nothing is written until you click this: it adds the exact package names to allowBuilds in the profile's pnpm-workspace.yaml (backup .bak-<timestamp> first, read back and verify, other fields untouched). It downloads and runs nothing itself; only the *next* pnpm install actually runs those scripts (a binary download plus native builds — measured ≈19 minutes the first time on this machine).
settings.pluginConsole.actionLongTitle: The console runs a whitelisted action inside its own process (only built-in kinds such as pin-dependency / reconcile-lock / allow-builds; a custom command string is never accepted). The command itself is display/copy only.
settings.pluginConsole.actionOverwritePresetLong: Nothing is overwritten until you click this: it re-fetches the preset from its recorded source repo, copies your whole current directory to <preset>.bak-<timestamp> first, then overwrites file by file and reads every file back to verify (a byte mismatch is reported, never hidden). By default assembly only adds missing files and never touches your same-name presets.
settings.pluginConsole.actionPartial: Partly done (manifest updated, lock not aligned)
settings.pluginConsole.actionPersistLabel: Pin it in one click (manifest + lock + mount row)

This list IS the custom git-source list — the two built-ins are just defaults; click Add git source to swap in your own: Gitee = https://gitee.com/{owner}/{repo}.git; GitLab = https://gitlab.com/{owner}/{repo}.git; self-hosted Gitea = https://your-domain/{owner}/{repo}.git; mirror proxy = https://mirror/https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}.git; local bare repo = file:///C:/repos/{owner}/{repo}.git.
